feature.label: MxAppsRCP Shared
feature.description: What every MxAppsRCP app is built on: the shared core bundle (Quick Help, menus, split panes, table copy, Back and Forward, links between the apps, the Layer 3 service catalog), PostgreSQL JDBC, Gson, Eclipse secure storage (Windows DPAPI) in place of the macOS Keychain, the JFace text editor and JNA.
